text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Burnview Crescent, between Bellamy Road North and Lawrence Avenue East. Staff's assessment indicates that the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Burnview Crescent.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Burnview Crescent, between Bellamy Road North and Lawrence Avenue East. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of nine speed humps on Burnview Crescent, between Bellamy Road North and Lawrence Avenue East, generally as shown on Attachments 2 and 3to the report (September 3, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
